subject: Policy-first lexical, vector, ANN, and artifact retrieval

implementation.authorization_order: Routing-only IndexPolicy metadata produces opaque snapshot/generation-bound universes before text, vector values, selectors, hashes, or blob locators may be materialized.
implementation.lexical: Tantivy indexes only authorized documents for each query, preventing denied text from altering corpus statistics, candidates, scores, order, or reported counts.
implementation.ann: HNSW is partitioned by the canonical full policy digest. Search accepts only authorized partition keys. A partial/tombstoned partition falls back to exact scoring over the authorized intersection and never traverses a denied bridge node.
implementation.artifact: Artifact and representation route tables are content-free. Original metadata, selectors, hashes, derived records, and locators are returned only after source and derived policy both authorize.
implementation.trace: Traces report authorized work only and contain no rejected counts, IDs, text, vector values, or partition cardinality.
